description: Curated, independently adjudicated EN/PL planner-compaction corpus. Development and held-out partitions are assigned before prompt tuning; held-out wording and combinations are not copies of development prompts. Gold plans express intended local propositions, not current-model outputs. Required atoms protect semantic boundaries and relation choice; compare plan denotations over available entities while preserving unknown. Notes state the discrimination each case is meant to exercise.

cases.question: Czy to Bośnia?
cases.notes: Bośnia is the supported short identity for Bosnia and Herzegovina.

cases.question: Is this Dominica—not the Dominican Republic?
cases.notes: The target identity is Dominica; the contrast excludes a different country rather than adding a condition.

cases.question: Are you Guinea-Bissau?
cases.notes: The hyphenated country name resolves to Guinea-Bissau, not Guinea.

cases.question: Czy to Antugua?
cases.notes: A one-edit typo maps to the known identity Antigua and Barbuda.

cases.question: Is the country name “Côte d’Ivoire”?
cases.notes: Quoted Unicode apostrophe text denotes the country name Côte d’Ivoire.

cases.question: Does its name contain the literal “–” (en dash)?
cases.notes: Quoted en dash is an ordinary exact substring, not a hyphen test.

cases.question: Czy nazwa zawiera łącznik?
cases.notes: Polish łącznik asks whether the name contains a hyphen character.

cases.question: Does the official name have a space?
cases.notes: The supported name relation is the executor’s common country name, not its official legal name; the official-name question needs unsupported data.

cases.question: Are you Nigeri?
cases.notes: Ambiguous near-match between Niger and Nigeria is not resolved by guessing.

cases.question: Does the country name start with “Saint” and have exactly two words?
cases.notes: Both name prefix and exact word-count criteria are required.

cases.question: Is its population greater than 1,000,000 people?
cases.notes: Strict population threshold in people; equality does not qualify.

cases.question: Czy powierzchnia nie przekracza 1000 km²?
cases.notes: Nie przekracza is inclusive; area is compared in stored square kilometres.

cases.question: Does the population reach at least 10 million?
cases.notes: At least includes equality; threshold refers to 10 million people.

cases.question: Czy powierzchnia jest mniejsza niż 500 km²?
cases.notes: Mniejsza niż is strict, applied to area in km².

cases.question: Is its population exactly 1,000,000?
cases.notes: Exact scalar equality, not a lower-bound test.

cases.question: Does the name have more than 10 characters?
cases.notes: Character count greater-than is strict.

cases.question: Czy nazwa ma mniej niż 3 wyrazy?
cases.notes: Word-count less-than is strict and counts words in the target name.

cases.question: Does its name have exactly 6 characters?
cases.notes: Exact character count in the name.

cases.question: Is its area larger than Poland’s area?
cases.notes: Comparison group is explicitly the named country Poland; compare area to area, not population.

cases.question: Czy stolicą jest Warszawa?
cases.notes: Capital equality against the canonical value Warsaw.

cases.question: Is it in Europe and a member of the EU?
cases.notes: Both continental classification and current EU membership must hold.

cases.question: Czy graniczy z Polską lub z Niemcami?
cases.notes: Either named neighboring country is sufficient.

cases.question: Is it neither in NATO nor in the EU?
cases.notes: Neither means not(A or B), preserving both membership clauses.

cases.question: Czy nie jest wyspą?
cases.notes: Negation applies to the stored island boolean.

cases.question: It borders France, but is not in the EU—does it fit?
cases.notes: But joins the positive border criterion with a negated EU-membership criterion.

cases.question: Is its population at least 1 million but below 5 million?
cases.notes: Two independent bounds: inclusive lower and strict upper.

cases.question: Does it border any country that belongs to NATO?
cases.notes: The NATO predicate binds each border-country item; it is not target NATO membership.

cases.question: Are all of its neighboring countries non-islands?
cases.notes: All quantifies over bordering countries and tests each item’s island status.

cases.question: Czy ma jakąkolwiek granicę lądową?
cases.notes: Question asks whether the known border list has any value, not for a neighbor attribute.

cases.question: Is it an island or does it have access to the Baltic Sea, but not both?
cases.notes: Exclusive-or: exactly one criterion holds; the plan preserves both mutually exclusive branches.

cases.question: Czy leży w Ameryce Południowej?
cases.notes: Broad continental membership, not a narrower subregion.

cases.question: Is it in Southeast Asia?
cases.notes: Southeast Asia is a specific geographic area, not all of Asia.

cases.question: Does it lie in the Middle East?
cases.notes: The region is Middle East, not a guessed continent or neighboring area.

cases.question: Is it a coastal country on the European continent?
cases.notes: Explicit continental membership plus recorded coastline, not a geopolitical regional label; both predicates must be retained.

cases.question: Czy znajduje się w Afryce Północnej?
cases.notes: North African geographic area, distinct from the whole continent.

cases.question: Is the country in Central America?
cases.notes: Central America is a narrower area within the wider continent.

cases.question: Is it entirely within the Northern Hemisphere?
cases.notes: Entirely in the Northern Hemisphere means Northern membership without Southern membership; territorial extent, not centroid alone.

cases.question: Does its territory cross the equator?
cases.notes: Cross-equator extent requires territory to occupy both Northern and Southern hemispheres.

cases.question: Is it in the Southern Africa region? I mean the region, not whether the target is South Africa.
cases.notes: Southern Africa is a broad regional area, not the country South Africa.

cases.question: Czy leży w północno-zachodniej Afryce?
cases.notes: Northwestern Africa is not represented as an exact supported area; northern Africa cannot substitute.

cases.question: Is its location in the Southern Hemisphere?
cases.notes: Asks for stored location hemisphere membership, not whether every part of territory lies there.

cases.question: Is its stored latitude greater than 0°?
cases.notes: Coordinate comparison locates the target north of latitude zero.

cases.question: Is it south of the Prime Meridian?
cases.notes: South is not a meaningful direction relative to the north–south Prime Meridian; clarify the intended geographic criterion rather than infer west.

cases.question: Does it have access to the Baltic Sea?
cases.notes: Named water-access list membership.

cases.question: Czy ma dostęp do oceanu?
cases.notes: Generic ocean access is asked as the supported water-access classification.

cases.question: Is it landlocked?
cases.notes: Landlocked means no recorded water access; negate list existence, not a specific sea.

cases.question: Does it border the Mediterranean Sea or the Black Sea?
cases.notes: Either of the two named water bodies qualifies.

cases.question: Is its latitude greater than 50 degrees north?
cases.notes: Latitude scalar uses degrees; threshold is strict.

cases.question: Czy leży na wschód od południka 30°?
cases.notes: Longitude east-of comparison with 30 degrees; degree unit explicit.

cases.question: Does a major river flow through it?
cases.notes: Whether the supported major-river list contains any entry.

cases.question: Is it currently a member of the European Union?
cases.notes: Current membership relation, unlike former membership.

cases.question: Czy należy do NATO lub Unii Europejskiej?
cases.notes: Current membership in either listed organization.

cases.question: Was it a founding member of NATO?
cases.notes: Founding status is historical event data not present in current membership facts.

cases.question: Czy było częścią ZSRR?
cases.notes: Historical-union relation records former USSR membership, not current political union membership.

cases.question: Is it currently part of the USSR?
cases.notes: The question asks about current membership; the membership relation encodes present status, without adding a historical-status exclusion.

cases.question: Is French an official language?
cases.notes: Tests official-language list membership, not prevalence or membership in a political organization.

cases.question: Czy hiszpański jest najczęściej używanym językiem?
cases.notes: Most widely spoken/prevalent language is not interchangeable with the supported official-language relation.

cases.question: Is the population ethnically Slavic?
cases.notes: Ethnic/cultural identity is unsupported; language or official language cannot stand in for it.

cases.question: Does it have a republic form of government?
cases.notes: Broad stored government category, not an inferred detailed subtype.

cases.question: Czy to monarchia konstytucyjna?
cases.notes: Constitutional monarchy is a detailed legal subtype; do not infer it from a broad monarchy label.

cases.question: Does traffic use the left side of the road?
cases.notes: Yes/no criterion compares the stored driving-side value with left.

cases.question: Czy ruch jest prawostronny i czy to wyspa?
cases.notes: Mixed-domain conjunction requires both right-hand traffic and island status; neither condition may be dropped.

cases.question: Is the euro its currency?
cases.notes: Currency list membership.

cases.question: Is Christianity the dominant religion?
cases.notes: Christianity includes the locally classified Catholic, Orthodox, Protestant, and generic Christianity dominant-religion categories; all four scalar values are included.

cases.question: Does the flag contain a star symbol?
cases.notes: Presence of a flag symbol, not its area or proportion.

cases.question: Is more than half of its flag blue?
cases.notes: Flag color proportions are not represented by flag-color presence facts.

cases.question: Is blue present among its flag colors?
cases.notes: Tests color presence only; no proportion inference.

cases.question: Does it share a land border with Côte d’Ivoire?
cases.notes: Named entity reference with Unicode apostrophe; asks direct border relation.

cases.question: Is its capital called “San José”?
cases.notes: Quoted accented capital-name literal is preserved.

cases.question: Does it lie in both Europe and Asia?
cases.notes: Both continental classifications are required; do not collapse a transcontinental question to either/or.

cases.question: Europe, borders France, population under five million?
cases.notes: Telegraphic fragment still specifies three conjunctive criteria.

cases.question: Czy populacja przekracza 2 miliony i czy nazwa kończy się na „stan”?
cases.notes: Mixed-style Polish predicate combines strict population bound and literal name suffix.

cases.question: Is it a Caribean country?
cases.notes: Existing documented typo pattern: misspelled Caribbean still indicates the Caribbean geographic area.

cases.question: Is the target the Republic of Korea?
cases.notes: Named identity refers to South Korea; not North Korea.

cases.question: Is it big?
cases.notes: “Big” supplies no measurable relation, threshold, or comparison criterion.

cases.question: Is it famous?
cases.notes: Fame is subjective and has no specified measurable criterion.

cases.question: Did it host the 2030 World Cup?
cases.notes: Precise event question requires external historical/event facts absent from local relations.

cases.question: Did it host the 2014 FIFA World Cup?
cases.notes: A specific past sporting event is an external fact absent from the supported local relations.

cases.question: Does it have a higher GDP than Poland?
cases.notes: GDP is a precise unsupported relation; do not substitute population or area.

cases.question: Is it a federal parliamentary republic?
cases.notes: Detailed government/legal subtype exceeds the broad supported government category.
